title: My game is on Steam woop!
author: All_Your_Wrestling
selftext:
Hi everyone,

  
I am a big pro-wrestling nerd and have always wanted my own management style game. So here I am! Have got quite a bit of negative feedback from other subs because of AI but I do not know how to code but I do have lots of ideas. So All Your Wrestling Pro Manager was born. I have enjoyed seeing some of the amazing work on this sub, so I thought I would post this and see what sort of feedback I get. Thanks :)

  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4979160/All\_Your\_Wrestling\_Pro\_Manager/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4979160/All_Your_Wrestling_Pro_Manager/)

comments.author: Livid_Shallot5701
comments.body: doesnt look bad. i am just confused about one thing: do i see matches in any way? or do i only see the result? a bit much "block of information" for me and missing some "visual action"

replies.author: All_Your_Wrestling
replies.body:
https://preview.redd.it/wbeu5oixdrhh1.png?width=1435&format=png&auto=webp&s=489b89f1cf8597a8ac6af7e2be7c8814466b0e9f

Hi, when you get to the event you see this screen. It has a slider of all the segments along the bottom, the current segment on the left and then some commentary on the right which goes through every few mins of the segment. This screen has been updated loads and I am very open to feedback :)

comments.author: All_Your_Wrestling
comments.body:
https://preview.redd.it/1pjav9zaerhh1.png?width=1437&format=png&auto=webp&s=ff7f5e3f77f0b72ec274533dba9462c1d14bb615

Thought I'd throw a couple more screens in 😄

comments.author: Mataza89
comments.body: This is the 5th identical text based wrestling booking sim released in 6 months using Claude. These and football managers have become saturated fast with AI

replies.author: All_Your_Wrestling
replies.body: Hi, I am a huge wrestling fan and love management games. I have spent so much time on this and yes, I cannot code (had the help for that) but I promise you all the ideas are my own and have been worked on and worked on and worked on. I don't begrudge anyone releasing a game as I know how much effort has still gone into creating it. Open for feedback of course all the time :)

comments.author: account009988
comments.body: You didn’t bother to make a custom ui?

replies.author: All_Your_Wrestling
replies.body: I did! :) but if it looks generic that's fine, this is why I'm posting so I can celebrate but also gather some feedback to improve 😄 I wanted it to have a FM sort of style

replies.author: All_Your_Wrestling
replies.body: yeah I used Codex to help build it but I wanted it to look this way, with a sidebar and then also in other screens to have a sidebar and a horizontal menu :)

replies.author: thvaz
replies.body: you are on fucking r/aigamedev, what did you expect?

comments.author: TheKaleKing
comments.body: Great job! What engine did you use to make it?

replies.author: All_Your_Wrestling
replies.body: Thanks! I built it using Codex to help with the coding. It’s been developed from scratch rather than using something like Unity or RPG Maker. I’m not a professional developer, so there’s been a lot of learning and trial and error along the way!

comments.author: All_Your_Wrestling
comments.body: Just an update: wanted to say a massive thank you as I haven't had any negativity. I have a few Steam keys available if anyone would like to give the game a test run! Just give me a message ❤️
